STAGE 1 - design exploration (metric_ideation_5).

GOAL: choose one hyperbolic SID-table quality metric that is in-contract and NOT a re-expression of Q_H (level-1 prefix kNN purity, +0.634), bucket count (-0.065), same-bucket ratio, hyp_voronoi_margin_l1 (-0.081) or hyp_adj_r2_l1 (+0.156).

WHAT I READ / OBSERVED: workspace dir contains only harness files (running.json, progress.jsonl, session.jsonl, stderr.log, opencode.json); read and glob are permission-denied, so no SID table, no reference arrays, no 97-pair file are inspectable. Therefore the proposal must be derived from the stated contract + the reported numbers only. Evidence: /fs04/ar57/wenyu/GeneRec/results/research/issue126/metric_round/round_20261029_211615/agents/metric_ideation_5 (glob listing; read rejected).

REASONING (rejections):
- Local margin between own-cell barycentre and nearest competing cell = hyp_voronoi_margin_l1, already failed.
- Between/within hyperbolic variance ratio = hyp_adj_r2_l1, already failed (and saturates).
- Hard kNN prefix purity / chance-corrected purity / MI = re-expresses Q_H or same-bucket ratio, banned.
- Hyperbolic disk-volume vs occupancy, Gromov four-point defect, geodesic-convexity defect: in-contract and cheap but weakly tied to the Stage-3 mechanism (beam search over SID tokens conditioned on the SOURCE item).
- Decisive observation: Q_H is a SYMMETRIC, target-side, level-1 statistic that saturates at levels 2-3 ("prefix becomes an item identifier"). Stage 3 is ASYMMETRIC (source -> target SID tokens) and SEQUENTIAL. So a complementary axis is the source-conditioned, per-token predictability of the true code, with the item's own contribution REMOVED so that a table cannot win by simply naming each item. That kills the level-2/3 saturation that Q_H suffers, and it is exactly the first-token / sibling-discrimination difficulty that gates beam-10 recall.

CHOSEN FAMILY: hyperbolic leave-one-out conditional code log-probability, averaged over (item, level) terms, with Poincare distance of curvature -1/R^2, hyperbolic Karcher (Frechet) barycentres as class prototypes, and the Riemannian exp/log one-step LOO mean update. Fixed constants: c = 1/R^2 from the reference, sigma = median_i d_c(u_i,v_i) from the frozen reference only (same for all 97 tables, so no per-table tuning), class sets = present codebook codes / sibling children (no free parameter).

OPEN: nothing blocking; next record is the finished answer block.

STAGE 2 - FINAL ANSWER produced (full text is in the assistant reply, not duplicated here because of the 4000-char record cap).

METRIC: hyp_loo_sid_logprob  --  mean over informative (item,level) terms of log p(true SID code | source rep), under a curvature-faithful prototype classifier.

Construction (self-contained summary): Poincare ball, curvature K = -1/R^2, c = 1/R^2, R from the frozen reference. d_c(x,y) = (2/sqrt(c)) arcosh(1 + 2c||x-y||^2/((1-c||x||^2)(1-c||y||^2))). Class prototypes B_pi = hyperbolic Karcher/Frechet barycentres of the target reps v_i in code-group G_pi, via x <- exp_x(mean log_x(v_i)). Own prototype is the Riemannian leave-one-out mean q = exp_{B_pi}(-log_{B_pi}(v_i)/(n_pi-1)); for n_pi = 1 fall back to the parent barycentre (level-1: global barycentre). Term: log p_{i,l} = z_own - logsumexp(z_own U {z_pi'}) with z = -d_c(u_i, .)^2/(2 sigma^2), sigma = median_i d_c(u_i,v_i) (one scalar from the frozen reference only, identical for all 97 tables). Denominator = present level-1 codes at l=1, and the CHILDREN OF THE ITEM'S OWN PARENT at l>=2 (bounded by 256, hence no item-identifier saturation). Metric = mean of log p over terms with |S|>=2 (unused/duplicate levels earn no free credit). Higher = better, range roughly [-log 256, 0].

Why it is in scope: explicit curved ops (geodesic distance, Karcher barycentre, Riemannian exp/log in the LOO update); inputs are only the SID table + the frozen per-item source/target reference vectors + R; no recall, no pairs, no Stage 2/3 run; all constants derived (c from R, sigma from the reference, class sets from the codebook/table arity, no tuning on the 97 recalls); one scalar, higher better.

Why it differs: adds an ASYMMETRIC (source->target), SEQUENTIAL (per token, parent-conditioned), chance-normalised, LEAVE-ONE-OUT axis to Q_H's symmetric target-side level-1 purity; LOO is what stops a table from winning by giving each item its own cell, which is exactly the level-2/3 saturation Q_H suffers. Not a margin (Voronoi), not a variance ratio (adj R2), not a bucket/same-bucket statistic.

Cost: <= 1.9e7 Poincare distances + <= 7.4M log/exp for barycentres, vectorised, a few seconds, < 60 s, ~6 MB at d=64.

Worst case: level-1 codes random w.r.t. the reference geometry (all terms at chance -log|S|), and geometry-blind near-singleton deep refinement (post-LOO own prototype reverts to the parent mixture while siblings sit on individual targets).

Status: answer block delivered to the caller; nothing open.
